flags.message: Possible moment-placement discrepancy: event.opened_at is 2026-11-09 and describes the first relist, but the frozen snapshot already records redistribution on 2026-11-02 for the November 6 conference after an initial October 16 conference, then a third distribution on November 9 for November 13. Context correctly freezes distribution_count=3. Forecast conditions on all three authoritative distributions, not a reconstructed first-relist state. If November 2 was an administrative reschedule rather than a true relist this may be benign; otherwise the first-relist cohort is placed one redistribution late.
